topic: Apple and Nvidia launch prices measured in PlayStation 5 consoles
title: Priced In: Tech Launch Prices Measured in PS5 Consoles #siliconverdict #pricedin #tech
description: Four famous tech launch prices, told in a single unit: the launch price of a disc PlayStation 5.
pinned_comment: The stand or the Mac Pro? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: A Mac Pro costs about fourteen PlayStation 5 consoles. Seriously.
One unit: a launch-price disc PS5, four hundred ninety-nine dollars. Stay for the last one.
Apple's Pro Display XDR stand cost nine hundred ninety-nine dollars, which is about two PlayStations.
Not the screen. Just the stand that holds it up, sold separately.
The Vision Pro launched at three thousand four hundred ninety-nine dollars, roughly seven PlayStations.
Now the prices get serious, and the numbers get weirder.
The Pro Display XDR itself launched at four thousand nine hundred ninety-nine dollars, about ten PlayStations.
Meanwhile the RTX 5090 Founders Edition launched at one thousand nine hundred ninety-nine dollars, about four consoles.
So one graphics card equals four whole game consoles, at launch prices.
And the 2023 Mac Pro started at six thousand nine hundred ninety-nine dollars, roughly fourteen PlayStations.
Fourteen game consoles for one desktop, and that was only the base model.
Next time you see a price tag, ask how many consoles it really is.
Follow for more. Which price shocked you most: the stand or the Mac Pro?
